Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines a time period with another “time of” expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，this refers to a concrete group of people in that period, so the plural noun is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，here the mother perceives an effect; 看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see/perceive.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他的妈妈搬家了，after the mother has already been mentioned, use a pronoun-based possessive phrase instead of repeating the full name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a habitual action, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以他没有朋友，this is a cause-and-effect relationship, so use 因为……所以…… rather than mixing 虽然 with 因为. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly phrased.
人 is too generic here; 人们 correctly refers to the people in that historical period.
看到 correctly expresses perceiving something, but the shown sentence still lacks 有 in 对孟子有不好的影响.
The teacher requires deleting the redundant repeated subject after 所以, whereas the proposed revision still unnecessarily states 孟子和他的妈妈.
Removing 了 correctly marks a habitual action, but the remaining 对他开玩笑 should be 跟他开玩笑 under the teacher's correction.
The revision correctly expresses the intended cause-and-result relationship with 因为……所以…….
